title: This clock makes noise constantly
text: This clock makes noise constantly. This clock makes noise constantly. I purchased it because the description was that it did not make any noise and it is a constant noise so I had to move it to a different location. I will need another one that is truly silent from somewhere else.

product_metadata.title: TOPZEA Retro Wall Clock, 12 Inch Silent Non-Ticking Round Classic Clock Decorative Quartz Battery Operated Wall Clock for Laundry, Living Room, Bedroom, Office, School, Home Decor, Brown
features: TOPZEA 12 inch retro wall clock is made of sturdy plastic case and HD glass lens, makes it easy to clean. Perfect for laundry room, living room, dining room, bedroom, office, hotel, school, ect.

Our decorative wall clock is easy to read. The retro dial with large easy to read black numbers, that is convenient for you to see the numbers from a distance easily. And it is covered with glass that keep dust away from dial and guarantee good view.

This classic wall clock with no ticking movement can provide a super quiet environment for you. You don't need to worry about the constant ticking of regular clocks, and can concentrate on working or enjoy living without disturbing.

The wide slot at the back of this silent wall clock is easy for you to install it, just hang it like a picture on any nail, screw or or small wall hook. Please insert one AA Battery (not included), and set time before you hang the clock.

This battery operated wall clock is very suitable for home decor at any room. The vintage frame design and the kraft paper color dial face show your elegant taste. It is also a great gift choice for housewarming, birthday, Christmas, Thanksgiving, New Year, ect.
